input:
/data/legacy holds text files in mixed encodings. For every file whose name ends in `.txt` (case-sensitive), write a normalised copy with the same name to /out/clean/: UTF-8 without BOM, line endings 
 and lone  converted to 
, and ending with exactly one added 
 if the text did not already end with 
.
Detect each file's encoding in this order: starts with a UTF-16 BOM (FF FE or FE FF) -> utf-16; starts with the UTF-8 BOM -> utf-8-sig; decodes as UTF-8 -> utf-8 (plain ASCII included); otherwise latin-1.
Write /out/manifest.tsv (tab-separated, header name, encoding, lines, chars) with one row per file sorted by name, where lines is the number of 
 and chars the number of Unicode characters in the normalised text (newlines included, BOM excluded).

python3 - << 'PY'
import os

src_dir = "/data/legacy"
dst_dir = "/out/clean"
manifest_path = "/out/manifest.tsv"

os.makedirs(dst_dir, exist_ok=True)

rows = []
# case-sensitive .txt, top-level files
names = sorted([n for n in os.listdir(src_dir) if n.endswith(".txt") and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(src_dir, n))])
print(names)
for name in names:
    src = os.path.join(src_dir, name)
    data = open(src, 'rb').read()
    # detection order
    if data[:2] == b'\xff\xfe' or data[:2] == b'\xfe\xff':
        enc = 'utf-16'
        text = data.decode('utf-16')
    elif data[:3] == b'\xef\xbb\xbf':
        enc = 'utf-8-sig'
        text = data.decode('utf-8-sig')
    else:
        try:
            text = data.decode('utf-8')
            enc = 'utf-8'
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            text = data.decode('latin-1')
            enc = 'latin-1'
    # normalise line endings: \r\n and lone \r -> \n
    norm = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')
    if not norm.endswith('\n'):
        norm = norm + '\n'
    # write UTF-8 without BOM
    dst = os.path.join(dst_dir, name)
    with open(dst, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(norm.encode('utf-8'))
    lines = norm.count('\n')
    chars = len(norm)
    rows.append((name, enc, lines, chars))
    print(f"{name}: {enc} lines={lines} chars={chars} repr={norm!r}")

# write manifest
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
with open(manifest_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as mf:
    mf.write('name\tencoding\tlines\tchars\n')
    for name, enc, lines, chars in rows:
        mf.write(f"{name}\t{enc}\t{lines}\t{chars}\n")

print("--- manifest ---")
print(open(manifest_path, 'rb').read().decode('utf-8'))
